purpose: English learning equivalents for the conjugation wheel
method: Primary English dictionary gloss plus explicit editorial normalizations; finite and nonfinite English patterns follow the currently visible Azerbaijani form. Original dictionary and grammar archives are not modified.
limits: A phrase-level teaching aid, not context-aware sentence translation. Azerbaijani and English tense/aspect/mood categories do not correspond one-to-one. Polysemous verbs use one selected sense. AI-assisted editorial material; no claim of comprehensive native-speaker verification.
source: Existing SÖZ dictionary; Wiktionary-derived dictionary material retains CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution.
